house_flat_number_apartment_building_nam: House/flat number, apartment/building name, street, nearby landmark, city, and 6-digit postal pincode.
selected_garment_categories_quantities_c: Selected garment categories, quantities, custom fabric instructions (e.g. starch preference, delicate silk care), and pickup/delivery date-time slots.
photographs_of_pre_existing_garment_stai: Photographs of pre-existing garment stains, tears, or tag markings captured by our doorstep logistics rider during bag sealing.
transaction_identifiers_payment_mode_cas: Transaction identifiers, payment mode (Cash on Delivery, UPI Dynamic QR, or Razorpay card/netbanking), and bank reference UTR numbers. We do
